start_here.title: Start here
start_here.body:
This is the team's wiki: what we know, how we work and what we decided, one page each. Anybody in the hub reads it; whoever may write changes a page and its history keeps every version.

## Find your way

- **How we write here** - the few rules that keep the wiki easy to read.
- **Team handbook** - how the team works, its meetings, its decisions and its guides.

Change these pages as your team changes: they are yours now, and a newer version of the template never rewrites them.

subpages.title: How we write here
subpages.body:
- One page, one subject; link to a page instead of repeating it.
- The first sentence says what the page is for.
- Mark a page as verified once it is right, and give it a review date, so nobody trusts a page that went stale.
- Write for the colleague who joins next month.

team_handbook.title: Team handbook
team_handbook.body: How this team works: who does what, when we meet and how we decide. Keep it short and keep it right.

subpages.title: Meeting notes
subpages.body: One page per meeting under this one: the date, who was there, what was decided and who does what by when.

subpages.title: Decisions
subpages.body: One page per decision that is hard to undo: the question, the options we weighed, what we chose and why.

subpages.title: How-to guides
subpages.body: Step-by-step guides for what the team does again and again, one task per page.
